source_rule.entry: SMA5>SMA20 while flat; equality does nothing; not necessarily a new crossover
source_rule.exit: SMA5<SMA20 while held; exit persists until completed

local_adaptations.universe: historical SH/SZ A only, identities deduplicated; current risk names excluded for current reports only
local_adaptations.ranking: bullish stocks sorted by prior20 average RMB turnover, then signal close turnover; exact final ties all displayed, ambiguous allocation boundary unfilled
local_adaptations.allocation: 100000 CNY, at most5 positions; each new position gross plus costs <=19% previous close NAV; >=5% reserve at order sizing; no daily rebalancing/no pyramiding
local_adaptations.liquidity: 20 complete quality bars, >=252 archive calendar sessions since first source record, prior20 average amount >=10000000 CNY; gross <=1% prior turnover; reject posthoc if >1% whole day shares
local_adaptations.timing: completed close signal, next exchange session open; missing pre-open frozen signal never backfilled into prospective entry
local_adaptations.orders: sells before buys; sale proceeds reused same day, T+1stock; no leverage; pending exits retained through blocks; unfilled entry expires that session, no hindsight replacements
local_adaptations.holding: until inverse MA inequality, no fixed number of days; deferred exits reported
local_adaptations.execution: conditional daily-bar scenario, one-price blocked and absolute opening gap>=4.5% blocked; not official limit/auction verification
local_adaptations.costs: commission3bps each side minimum5 CNY, transfer2/1 tenths bp before/from2022-04-29, sell stamp10/5bps before/from2023-08-28, adverse slippage10bps eachside; repeat with allcosts2x
local_adaptations.company_actions: verified explicit cash/net/share events supported; incompatible factor intervals without event freeze that position and make NAV incomplete; no dividend/split inferred from factor
local_adaptations.unavailable_mark: retain position/cash, carry lastmark only as indicative; total NAV/returns withheld when incomplete; no liquidation at stale prices

admission.historical: positive net and benchmark difference in each period, positive2xcost, no unresolved NAV or execution-data gaps, chronological block uncertainty excludes0
admission.forward: genuine pre-entry frozen records; strategy/engine/data versions fixed; complete results and practical risk/cost review; no automatic certification by elapsed days

normal_use: free/noaccount/autodependencies/no broker orders; standing conditional paper account updated on invocation, no unattended service implied
